title: Upstream crosslink observation: agent hook-enforcement looser than docs — plain push/merge/rebase allowed while docs claim 'no push, no merge, gated commits'

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: SOURCE (attended-design knowledge page, 2026-07-20 deep read of the crosslink repo): the shipped agent_overrides reduce the agent hook block list to destructive-ops only — plain git push/merge/rebase are ALLOWED at the hook layer — while container-agents.qmd, kickoff.qmd, tracking-modes.qmd, and the generated KICKOFF.md prompt all claim 'no push, no merge, gated commits' for agents. The strict blocks are prompt-level (soft/normative) only; hook enforcement is deliberately looser than every doc says. Impact on vsdd: our dispatch-posture and trust-boundary reasoning cites the documented behavior; the enforced behavior is weaker. Ask: align docs to code or tighten agent_overrides.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Rolled into the kickoff epic: https://github.com/magnificentlycursed/crosslink/issues/2 (tracks the full vsdd kickoff bundle with upstream dollspace-gay/crosslink links; check-off happens there as upstream fixes land).
